state_cases: P001-P024 emit TRACE_BEGIN, every exact Debug Event and returned Effect vector, public State counters/latch/headroom/waiters after each transition, and TRACE_END after terminal assertions
policy_cases: P025-P026 emit DRAIN_TRACE with each exact token, monotonic evaluation time, peer snapshot and production result, then TRACE_END
run_condition: For P001-P024 require an exact matching case ID and event ordinal in a post-on_event effects receipt, printed only after production on_event returned; preserve the subsequent state receipt when validation succeeds. For P025-P026 require the matching DRAIN_TRACE printed after production fleet_status returned. TRACE_BEGIN, constructor/setup, compilation, discovery and zero-test exits alone never count as SUT runs.
pass_condition: Exactly one selected test succeeds and its matching TRACE_END appears, with immutable pins and owned-process cleanup verified
limitations: Event/effect receipts are native decision-core evidence. Supplied sample/completion facts are not measurements, actual operations, real runtime eviction or VM proof. Do not fabricate receipts before an authorized run.
precondition_failure: Unavailable source/toolchain/resource guard/authorization or failed setup/precondition is BLOCKED, not a semantic product failure and never a semantic pass. Do not count a run without the required production-return receipt; preserve diagnostic evidence separately.
